name: Monthly design system keeper
why: Finds drift from your design rules in code each month and checks contrast when colours move, the same job as the monthly health check workflow.

name: Prepare a design system migration
why: Builds the change inventory, replacement rules and staged rollout that the release and migration skill asks for.

name: Give developers a complete component brief
why: Turns one component design into variants, every state, keyboard rules and tokens, like the component spec skill.

name: Design handoff completeness assistant
why: Finds states and variants missing from a changed component before build, matching the handoff completeness prompt.

name: Write design rules, check colours and hand developers a spec
why: Takes a brief through design rules, contrast-checked colours and tokens to a developer spec, a lighter version of the starter system workflow.

name: New screen design reviewer
why: Checks each new screen against your own design rules, a quick way for product teams to stay inside the system between monthly checks.

name: Visual system rules writer
why: Writes firm colour, type and grid rules from a brand's feeling, a useful input before tokens are named.

name: Build a brand file and style guide from scratch
why: Produces the brand rules and style guide a token set is built from, for teams with no brand sheet yet.
